title: Chris Brown Says He Hasn’t Seen His Daughter in 7 Months Amid Custody Battle: ‘I Take Care of All My Kids’
summary: The R&B superstar's other three baby mothers all came forward praising Brown as a father.
contentText:
Chris Brown is speaking out after allegedly not being able to see his four-year-old daughter, Lovely, for the last seven months amid a custody battle with his baby mother, Diamond Brown.

Breezy posted a lengthy rant to his Instagram Story on Monday (Oct. 5), claiming that he pays for all of Diamond and Lovely’s expenses, plus $10,000 a month, even though he hasn’t seen his daughter since March.

“NOT ENTERTAINING IGNORANCE! Not allowing me to have time with my child so you can run with a false narrative to the courts is disgusting,” he wrote. “There is no 50/50 co parenting. I LITERALLY PAY FOR EVERYTHING, her cars(2), her HOUSE, SCHOOLING, MEDICAL, and 10K a month.”

Brown continued: “I HAVENT SEEN MY DAUGHTER IN 7 months I DONT CARE ABOUT This BITTER BABYMOMMA or who she date. I CARE ABOUT MY CHILD. I wanna know what she tells LOVELY when she asks about her dad.”

According to TMZ, Brown and Diamond are entrenched in child support and custody battles, with Diamond Brown seeking full physical custody and increased child support. She reportedly claimed that Brown has made threats against her new boyfriend.

On Monday, Diamond responded to the singer’s claims on social media, dispelling the notion that she’s denied him visitation rights.

Brown’s baby mother said she invited Brown to a recent New York Fashion Week event their daughter participated in, but he allegedly left her on read and did not show up.

Diamond also denied Chris Brown, whom she called the “king of f–kery,” ever sending her a monthly $10,000 payment, and claimed that he’s subtracted money from the total he’s sent due to her dating other men.

“You did subtract money when you found out I was dating and I do have proof of this,” she said. “If you wanted to see your daughter, you would.”

Chris Brown’s three other baby mothers (Nia Guzman, Ammika Harris and Jada Wallace) all posted messages of support on social media complimenting Breezy when it comes to his fatherly duties following Diamond’s criticism.

“Diamond please every one of us is OVERLY taken care of and you know that. Stop being ungrateful and miserable,” Wallace wrote.

Harris added: “All of the children are very well taken care of by their dad. They always have been and always will be. EVERYTHING EQUALLY!!!! Let’s be real, girly!”

C. Breezy remains on the road for his expansive R&B Tour with Usher. The trek heads to Houston this weekend for a pair of shows on Oct. 9 and Oct. 10 at Reliant Stadium. On the music front, CB released his Brown album in May, which debuted at No. 7 on the Billboard 200.

Billboard has reached out to Chris Brown’s reps for comment.
